stories.title: Five more drones downed en route to Moscow
stories.summary: MOSCOW, August 15. At least five more drones have been taken down on the way to Moscow, the Russian capital’s Mayor Sergey Sobyanin said on the Max messenger. "The Defense Ministry’s air defense units have downed five more enemy drones approaching Moscow," he wrote on the Max messenger. Previously, the mayor reported that seven Moscow-bound drones had been destroyed.
